name: Le Long Dinh
role: Third son of Lê Đại Hành, winner of the eight-month succession struggle, last Tiền Lê king
known_facts: Won the eight-month fratricidal war against his brothers Lê Long Việt, Lê Long Tích and Lê Long Kính after Lê Đại Hành's death
Traditional histories brand him cruel and call him Ngọa Triều — the king who held court lying down
The Toàn thư records six personal campaigns to defend Tiền Lê territory (Phù Lan, Đô Lương, Vị Long, Hoan Đường, Thạch Hà…)
In 1007 sent a white elephant and envoys to the Song to request the cửu kinh and Đại Tạng scriptures
Died leaving young sons; power passed to Lý Công Uẩn
interpretation: Late-Tiền Lê royal dress based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
